in_marathi.name: Kunika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kunika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kunika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ku' meaning prosperity and 'Nika' meaning goddess. Kunika is the goddess of prosperity and abundance. She is often depicted with a lotus in her hand, symbolizing her connection to nature and the cycle of birth, death, and rebirth.
